item.title: Google UK Data Center Faces 55,000-Signature Petition
item.description:
Google's planned large data center in Thurrock, east of London, faces a petition signed by nearly 55,000 people, backed by an unusual coalition of wildlife groups, an anti-pollution nonprofit and a local motorcycle club concerned about habitat loss and pollution. The case is part of a broader European backlash against data centers, highlighting growing community and policy resistance to AI compute expansion.

原文标题：谷歌英国数据中心遭 5.5 万人联名反对

Why it matters：反映 AI 算力扩张遭遇地方阻力这一结构性趋势，对关注基础设施与产业落地的读者有参考价值。

item.title: Qwen Office 2.0 Launches Team Agent for Multi-User Collaboration
item.description:
Qwen Office released version 2.0, debuting a 'Collaboration' feature that lets digital employees join team workspaces alongside human members. It also adds proactive 'Auto Tasks' triggered by events, plus human-AI co-creation, a resource space and three-device sync, shifting office agents from personal assistants to team-level agents.

原文标题：千问办公 2.0 发布 推出首个多人 Agent 协作功能

Why it matters：这是办公 Agent 从个人助手迈向团队协作形态的产品节点，多人与 Agent 同空间协作及主动任务触发值得关注。

item.title: Alibaba Launches Qwen Office 2.0 with Multi-User Agent Collaboration
item.description:
Alibaba released Qwen Office 2.0, positioned as a Team Agent for individual and organizational collaboration, marking the first support for multiple humans and agents working in a shared space. The update adds five core capabilities: collaboration, automated tasks, human-AI co-creation, a resource space, and three-device connectivity, with digital employees able to link DingTalk group chats, documents, AI spreadsheets and meeting notes in real time and trigger proactive tasks via event subscriptions. All features are now fully available in the Qwen Office client.

原文标题：阿里千问办公 2.0 发布 支持多人与 Agent 协作

Why it matters：这是 Agent 从个人助手走向团队协作场景的代表性产品落地，多人与 Agent 同空间协作及事件触发式自动任务值得关注。

item.title: Winbond Plans EUV for 14nm DRAM, Targets 2030 Rollout
item.description:
Winbond general manager Chen Pei-ming said the company plans to adopt EUV lithography in its second-generation 14nm-class DRAM process, targeting 2030 if development goes smoothly, with the first ASML EUV tool due in about two years. Winbond also approved a NT$71.363 billion budget for its Kaohsiung Module B build and expects limited impact on AI data center construction in 2027-2028, while CSP funding in 2029 will determine whether the market enters a downturn.

原文标题：华邦电子拟在 14nm DRAM 导入 EUV 光刻 目标 2030 年量产

Why it matters：利基型存储厂商首次明确 EUV 导入时间表，是观察成熟制程 DRAM 与 AI 存储供给的重要信号。

item.title: Google to Shut Down Firebase Studio in March 2027, Pushing Users to Antigravity or AI Studio
item.description:
Google's browser-based IDE Firebase Studio is winding down: new workspace creation and sign-ups were disabled in June, and the product will formally close on March 22, 2027, with all remaining data permanently deleted. Users are being directed to migrate to alternatives such as Google Antigravity or Google AI Studio. Launched in preview on April 10, 2025, the tool centered on AI chat-assisted app prototyping and tweaking, though code editing remained its core function.

原文标题：谷歌 Firebase Studio 将于 2027 年 3 月关闭，用户需迁移至 Antigravity 或 AI Studio

Why it matters：涉及谷歌 AI 开发工具线的产品退场与迁移路径，对使用 Firebase Studio 的开发者有直接行动价值。

item.title: NVIDIA Plans Investments in Korean AI Startups Including Point2, Motif, RLWRLD and Upstage
item.description:
NVIDIA and South Korea's Ministry of Science and ICT hosted an AI startup partnership forum at COEX in Seoul, where NVIDIA announced an investment in AI interconnect firm Point2 and plans for additional investments in Motif Technologies, RLWRLD and Upstage. The four targets span AI interconnect, agent foundation models, robotics foundation models and enterprise LLMs, signaling NVIDIA's capital and compute ties across Korea's AI ecosystem.

原文标题：英伟达宣布投资韩国 AI 初创企业 Point2 等四家公司

Why it matters：英伟达以资本方式绑定韩国 AI 生态，标的覆盖互联芯片、智能体模型与机器人基础模型，是观察其区域布局的重要信号。

item.title: Musk Defends SpaceX-Anthropic Compute Deal as Two-Way Contract
item.description:
Elon Musk pushed back on criticism of SpaceX's compute deal with Anthropic, stressing the contract cuts both ways: SpaceX could exit with 90 days' notice and reprice if supply tightens, but would also lose revenue if compute becomes cheap. The deal runs to May 2029 at roughly $1.25B per month, totaling nearly $45B for dedicated Colossus cluster capacity.

原文标题：马斯克回应 SpaceX 与 Anthropic 算力协议：合同双向，谁也别抱怨

Why it matters：头部 AI 公司与算力供应方之间巨额长约的定价与退出机制，是判断算力市场供需与议价权走向的关键信号。

item.title: China Telecom's Tianyi Terminal and UBTECH Sign Strategic Pact to Scale Humanoid Robots
item.description:
Tianyi Telecom Terminal, a wholly owned China Telecom subsidiary, signed a comprehensive strategic cooperation agreement with UBTECH and unveiled a joint innovation lab. The partners aim to push family companion robots past one million units and humanoid robots past 100,000 units industry-wide within three years, combining robot procurement, leasing pilots and bidirectional capability packaging with Telecom's cloud, AI models and eSIM. No product specs, investment figures or delivery timelines were disclosed.

原文标题：中国电信天翼终端与优必选达成战略合作 共推人形机器人规模化落地

Why it matters：这是运营商渠道与人形机器人厂商的规模化落地合作，方向值得关注，但目前仅为框架协议，缺乏可验证的产品与商业细节。

item.title: Samsung SDI to Supply Batteries for Boston Dynamics' Atlas Robot
item.description:
Samsung SDI has been selected to supply batteries for Boston Dynamics' Atlas humanoid robot, handling nearly all initial shipments while LG Energy Solution's limited capacity keeps it a secondary source. Atlas is slated for mass production in 2028 or later, with a pack of 70 2170 cylindrical cells totaling about 1.3 kWh.

原文标题：三星 SDI 将为波士顿动力 Atlas 供应电池

Why it matters：人形机器人量产供应链落地的具体信号，电池规格与量产时间表首次明确。

item.title: China's CAC Launches Unified Filing System for Generative AI and Algorithms
item.description:
China's Cyberspace Administration launched a unified filing system on November 9, 2026, consolidating registration for generative AI, algorithms, deep synthesis and blockchain into a single portal, replacing the previous separate algorithm and blockchain filing systems. The platform supports lookups by entity name, filing name and filing number, marking a shift toward a one-stop compliance channel for AI services in China.

原文标题：网信办上线新备案系统 生成式 AI 与算法备案一体化

Why it matters：国内生成式 AI 合规申报入口统一，直接影响所有在华提供 AI 服务企业的备案流程。

item.title: AI Data Center Power Crunch: Gas Turbine Lead Times Stretch Into 2030s, Secondhand Market Booms
item.description:
Surging AI data center power demand has made gas turbines a critical bottleneck for compute expansion: global order backlog exceeds 100GW against 60-70GW of manufacturing capacity, pushing new-unit lead times to 2030-2031. Utilities, developers and data center power providers are scrambling for secondhand and refurbished units, even aeroderivative turbines, though analysts say limited spare supply will barely ease delays.

原文标题：AI 数据中心抢电：燃气轮机新机排到 2030 年代，二手市场火爆

Why it matters：揭示 AI 算力扩张正被电力设备供给卡住，是理解数据中心建设节奏与能源约束的关键产业信号。

item.title: Microsoft Patent Filing Targets Real-Time AI Speech Rewriting with Lip Sync
item.description:
Microsoft has filed patent application US 2026/0341309 A1 describing a system that rewrites live speech almost in real time: an AI agent monitors audio and flags words to alter or remove based on preset rules or viewer profiles (age, language, residence), then generative AI replaces the audio, smooths transitions and regenerates mouth movements to match, with playback delayed roughly 1 to 10 seconds. The filing also covers live translation and deployment on AR glasses, phones and cameras, but examiners rejected the relevant claims on July 29, 2026, and Microsoft has not confirmed any product plans.

原文标题：微软申请新专利：AI 实时改写直播语音并同步唇形

Why it matters：专利细节具体，涉及实时语音替换、唇形重绘与观众画像过滤，是观察 AI 内容篡改与合规边界的重要信号。

The facelifted S-Class drops Drive Pilot, and Mercedes will skip further L3 iterations to concentrate on Level 2 assistance and Level 4 autonomy.

item.title: Alibaba Cloud Raises Token Plan Quotas by Over 70% at Unchanged Monthly Fees
item.description:
Alibaba Cloud has raised the quotas of its Token Plan personal subscriptions, boosting Lite, Essential and Standard tiers by roughly 74% to 78% with monthly fees unchanged, cutting per-credit cost by over 40%. The Pro tier now offers 200,000 credits at a reduced monthly fee of RMB 312, down about 37.5%, with existing subscribers receiving the new quotas as well.

原文标题：阿里云 Token Plan 额度上调超 70% 月费不变

Why it matters：头部云厂商大幅下调单位 Token 成本，是观察大模型推理价格战与开发者用云成本的重要信号。

item.title: Nadella Envisions 20 Million AI Agents Working Alongside 200,000 Microsoft Employees
item.description:
Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella floated a hypothetical in which the company's 200,000 employees work alongside 2 million to 20 million AI agents, likening the shift to the 1980s spread of office typists. He said he already runs 100 concurrent CLI agent sessions and that Microsoft built an 'agent development environment' to manage the cognitive load.

原文标题：纳德拉设想微软未来 2000 万智能体与 20 万员工协同

item.title: NautilusTrader 开源交易框架获 3.1 万星
item.description:
NautilusTrader 是一个基于 Python 与 Rust 的高性能开源算法交易框架，采用模块化架构，支持回测与实盘交易使用同一套代码。该项目在 GitHub 上已积累超过 3.1 万星，是量化交易领域较受关注的开源基础设施之一。

Why it matters：虽非 AI 核心事件，但作为高星开源量化交易框架，对关注 AI 金融应用与智能体落地的读者有参考价值。

item.description:

item.description:

Why it matters：全球 AI 算力核心供应商的最高管理层出现治理与安全双重风险，是影响整个 AI 产业链信心的关键事件。

item.title: 基元律动发布 NeoHorse-1.5-Flash 预览版，Agent 模型 RSI 进入第二轮迭代
item.description:
基元律动发布 Agent 原生模型 NeoHorse-1.5-Flash Preview，基于 Qwen3.8-Flash 训练，总参数 180B、激活参数 6B，重点提升 Agent 任务执行与软件工程能力，目前限量内测。官方对照评测显示，相较基座模型，该模型在 Agents' Last Exam 上提高 9.23 分、Natural Language to Repository 上提高 5.92 分，物理科学任务提升超 20 分。发布延续了其递归自我改进（RSI）路线，通过多模型平台与开源 Agent 产品 OpenSquilla 收集执行反馈并转化为训练信号。

Why it matters：国产 Agent 原生模型以 RSI 闭环迭代并给出具体评测增益，对关注 Agent 训练范式的读者有参考价值。
